Class FSMArchitecture

java.lang.Object
org.swarmforge.core.behavior.FSMArchitecture
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReasoningArchitecture
public class FSMArchitecture extends Object implements ReasoningArchitecture
Finite State Machine implementation for ant behavior. Classic approach with states like EXPLORING, FORAGING, RETURNING, etc.
